LESSON: SPECIFIC MORNING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Specific morning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Specific morning. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which prayer do you recite in Prayers learner should be able to: guide learners in recitation of the morning?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91
2. appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SPECIFIC MORNING
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Specific morning helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SPECIFIC MORNING
Study Specific morning like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91

What this means
In this part you learn to recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Specific morning” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Specific morning in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Specific morning is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Specific morning” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Specific morning in your own words. (skill: appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Specific morning to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Specific morning from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Specific morning: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Specific morning?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which prayer do you recite in Prayers learner should be able to: guide learners in recitation of the morning?
2. Which rituals do you observe morning prayers used for importance of prayers in worship at the places of worship?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Specific morning means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recite the specific Pratahkaal Sandhya morning prayers of the Japji Sahib four faiths for spiritual Samayik nourishment. Om Meditation. 91.
5. Be able to: appreciate the prayers as  The learner be encouraged to a way of communication recite prayers in groups with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious.
